envs.name: luacode
envs.doc: The luacode environment is similar to \luaexec, except that you can now use % and # directly (but \% and \# also work) and the line breaks are respected, so that you can use line-wise Lua comments in the normal way, without mistakenly commenting the rest of the chunk.
